The OpenGameArt page identifies the download as 3D art, names taradavies as
the author, and marks the work CC0. The checked-in `.blend` is the unmodified
official download, renamed only to make its origin explicit.

## Excluded external image dependencies

The source `.blend` refers to `004_Half.jpg`,
`seamless-wood-texture-free-23.jpg`, and an external HDR environment. Those
files are neither packed in the official download nor licensed separately on
the source page. A source-page comment also asks where the textures came from
without a recorded answer. The reproducible project build therefore removes
every source material and image reference before adapting the geometry. None
of those missing files, nor a reconstruction of them, is included in the
editable derivative or runtime exports.

The delivered wood base-color and roughness maps are newly generated by the
project's deterministic Blender build and contain no pixels copied from the
missing source images. Their project-authored contribution is covered by the
repository's root MIT license; the adapted firearm geometry retains the source
CC0 dedication.
